reviews.x: I purchased this doubled sided tape to use on the inside of a face mask/covering to keep the my glasses from fogging up during use.  It works great and is easy to remove from both my skin and the fabric.  This tape has left no marks on my nose after use, and keeps the face mask in place.  I would definitely recommend this tape to anyone who has sensitive skin.

After only wearing these for a few hours, upon trying to remove them - they did not want to come off and left red marks for 2 days.  The adhesion is amazing and you don't have to worry about anything slipping or moving, but my skin was irritated and red and it was very difficult to remove.

I bought these to stick down my cloth mask to my face. I wear it 8 hours a day to work in a grocery store and I am very happy with them! They keep my glasses from fogging up, they don’t leave any kind of mark on my skin (which is very sensitive) and they come off easily. You can get a few uses out of it as well, I can take off and re-stick about 4-5 times before it doesn’t want to stick anymore.

I did read other reviews where people thought it was still painful taking off the tape. I have very sensitive skin so that why I settled on this style. Although it’s not the most painless ordeal, I can handle it because it gets the job done. I even goofed up and didn’t stick to my dress the way I wanted. It restuck with no issues.
Used these to hold down a romper in areas that were very exposing. Held up all night even with sweat. Also used them to make a shirt shorter and it held up.

reviews.t: Didn't Work for My Wedding Dress
reviews.x: I ordered this tape specifically to use with my wedding dress.  My dress had been too big, and after alteration the straps did not lay flat on my body.  Even using a lot of tape, it wasn't strong enough to hold down the fabric which was sheer with some beading.  I think this product would work well on regular clothes, but I wouldn't recommend it for a wedding dress.

This tape is advertised as good for sensitive skin. Well, I have sensitive skin, so I ordered it. I attached one side to my skin and the other to a blouse. It didn't take long for the blouse to detach, so it looked horrible with random tape around my upper chest area. I removed the tape and was left with red marks for several days. reviews.t: The purpose of this product is to be sticky..
reviews.x: I attempted using these three times, each time I ended up throwing them away mid-use because they weren't doing anything. After about an hour it was a free viewing party to all involved.

reviews.t: Great for face mask support too!
reviews.x: Bought this product to attach a cloth mask to my face when going for a haircut. I wanted them in case the stylist might need to move the ear loops for any reason. I was a little concerned as my face can definitely be sensitive - but no problems. No noticeable adhesive smell in my batch so far. Removing wasn’t pleasant, but also not the worst thing. And best of all no red marks where the glue had been. I was able to safely and securely attach the mask and it held the entire time. Very happy with

Braless with a really low neckline? This is your next purchase. It survived two nights of a drunken bridal party dancing and running around. This stuff is truly magic. It kept low neck lines from slipping, shoulder straps from moving, and boobs from falling out. Really, this is the ultimate tool for keeping everything together. I have super sensitive skin and it didn’t bother me at all.
The product overview stated for sensitive skin but after 30 minutes of wear I had to remove because it caused redness on my skin

It did great at keeping things where I wanted them! I didn’t experience any redness or irritation. Easy to remove.
Horrible!!!, doesn’t stick to anything, left burns all over my skin and ruined my dress

I use these tape strips for the nose/bridge of my masks and they work great. My mask never slips up to hurt my eyes and my glasses hardly ever fog up. I remove it at lunch time and can reapply it for my afternoon shift. These are a God send! Very affordable too. Keep masking up so we can beat this pandemic!!

reviews.t: This product should be in everyone’s junk drawer.
reviews.x: I used this tape inside of a face mask in order for the mask to stick to my face instead of using the loops behind the ears. I did this for the sole purpose of visiting the hair salon. The stylist could do her job unimpeded  without the ear loops in the way.

reviews.t: Super adhesive! Careful of skin. Works though!
reviews.x: Stuck REALLY well all night to keep the super low V of my dress in place. Unfortunately that night when I went to peel it off, it took a long chunk of my SKIN WITH IT!!

reviews.t: Best hack for making my N95 mask perfect for fog free glasses
reviews.x: I am a dental hygienist and wear a medical grade N95 mask for a minimum of 8 hours per day. The fearless tape is amazing at sealing the mask across the bridge of my nose preventing air leaks  and fogging of my glasses.  It adheres very well (almost too well). When removing the mask my advice is to very slowly peel the edge of the mask from one side of the nose across the bridge.  I recommend this “hack” for anyone who is wearing a mask and has problems with fogging glasses.

I love using Fearless sensitive tape as it doesn't react with my skin. I have used this tape on many clothes and it sticks well. It has even gone through the washer and dryer multiple times and it still holds. Even getting hot, sweaty, and wet at an amusement park....it held. This tape has also been used to hold a skirt together like pants to play hackie sack.

reviews.t: Works great as a mask closure!
reviews.x: These are perfect. I am using these to ensure closure of my mask when out in public. They work great! And with the filter addition, they are as close to N95 as I can get.
Used to hold my mask in place at work. With repeated use it did leave some marks on my cheeks but it was expected. Held mask in place.

I bought this to hold my elf ears on.  Naturally, with ridiculously sensitive skin, I tested it first.  I put a piece of tape on the inside of my wrist.  Within ten minutes it was a bit red underneath and starting to itch.  But, I left it because it didn't start raising up into hives and I wanted to see what it would do. reviews.x: I was excited to buy this product to see if it would actually keep my swimsuit in place. After using this product, I unfortunately was extremely disappointed. I wound up using a few strips to keep my suit attached to my cleavage to prevent any nip slips. I used 3 on each side to ensure that nothing would fall out. claims.text: Many reviewers find the tape holds clothing and masks securely in place, even through sweat and long wear.
Several reviewers report skin irritation, redness, rashes, or burns, especially those with sensitive skin.
Some reviewers say the tape is easy to remove and leaves no marks, while others find removal difficult or painful.
A number of reviewers report the tape does not stick well or fails to hold fabric, sometimes coming off within an hour.
Some reviewers with sensitive skin say the tape caused no problems for them.
